scientific_integrity: Standard Riesz multiplier, Poisson Gaussian identity and Jacobi triple product are prior mathematical ingredients, not new results. The claimed new work is the explicit sharp all-real two-neighbor optimization, exact interior extremal-frequency equation, and improved exponential asymptotic conditioning.
scientific_limitations: Optimality holds only among real nearest-neighbor two-Gaussian generators, up to reciprocal scaling. More general finite-impulse-response and complex coefficients are not optimized; the sharp condition constant has a unique implicit scalar root. The infinite proof is analytic, numerical checks are finite corroboration. Historical priority remains best-knowledge and independent validation has not been performed.
title: The sharp two-neighbor filter for Gaussian shift-invariant Riesz conditioning
